item.title: Public Health Mobile Team: Skyland Fire Safety Day — Sat Jul 25, 9:00 AM — Biltmore Church - Arden Campus - 35 Clayton Rd Arden NC 28704
item.description:
Come on out to the third annual Skyland Fire Department Safety Day!
This free, family-friendly event will feature fire safety education, home and community safety resources, health and wellness information, health screenings, apparatus tours, fire truck rides, a junior firefighter combat challenge, inflatables, food trucks, live music from DJ Bill Keel, and more. Local public safety agencies, health partners, and community vendors will be on site with demonstrations, educational booths, and activities for all ages.
The event will be held rain or shine, and attendees are encouraged to bring lawn chairs and blankets to enjoy the music, food, and family activities. A covered tent and seating area will be available. Come spend the day with Skyland Fire Department and our community partners as we work together to build a safer, healthier community https://www.buncombenc.gov/calendar.aspx?EID=10789
Source: Buncombe County Public Health Mobile Team

item.title: July Write-A-Thon — Sat Jul 25, 10:00 AM
item.description:
AVL Writers Join AVL Writers for an independent writing session. Unlike the usual events, this will be an independently focused writing session held at Odd’s Cafe. This isn’t about sharing your writing. It’s about having a time and place to work on it with minimal distraction.
Silence or headphones encouraged, but light conversation can always happen, so be ready for it. All writers welcome regardless of experience level.
Introductions will occur at the beginning of the session and you’re encouraged to show up a good few minutes before. Five-minute breaks will be announced and recommended at every hour interval to help everyone keep pace. Don’t worry about staying all four hours. Feel free to show up or leave at your leisure.

item.title: Fun & easy way to play more tennis (please read event description for details) — Tue Aug 11, 7:00 PM
item.description:

These Meetups are co-ed, super laid back, and all skill levels are welcome. Post your skill level and a suggested court in the comments section so we can round up as many players as we can for some tennis fun!
Also, if you’re looking to meet new practice partners or play some matches and you aren’t already in the PlayYourCourt Community, you can go here to see what we’re all about and sign up:
https://www.playyourcourt.com/tennis-community/asheville-nc/meetup/
If you love tennis, we’d love to have you! Be sure and watch the quick video that explains how everything works.
Happy hitting!
- Scott

item.description:
Asheville Introverts Come see a variety of antique vehicles at the Estes-Winn Antique Car Museum! Located at the historic Grovewood Village in North Asheville, the museum features antique and vintage cars and even an Asheville City fire truck from 1922! Admission to the museum is free with a $5 suggested donation. There are two parking lots at Grovewood Village, one by the museum and one behind the restaurant. For more information about the museum or about Grovewood Village, please visit their website: [https://www.grovewood.com/antique-car-museum/](https://www.grovewood.com/antique-car-museum/) We hope to see you there!

item.title: Shut Up & Write!® in Candler/West Asheville — Mon Aug 17, 2:00 PM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina Please join me and other local writers for a group writing session. Bring whatever you're working on and grab a coffee, and we will write alongside each other.
This is not a critique group, but we do have short social periods before and after writing. \-\-\- Many have mentioned that The Dripolator is a little hard to find if you've never been before. The coffeeshop is located in a strip mall where the Candler YMCA is, and the sonic. The Dripolator is next to the bank, and looks a little like a house. There is usually plenty of parking in the lot out front. If you're having trouble send me a message!
